name: Canvas Launch
description: A scroll-told launch page for a design tool, every scene pinned and handed over in place: an opening mark that dives through its own window, the product's editor drawn in code with a camera that flies into its inspector, no-translation-layer and change-journal diagrams, Magic Cast, parallel assistant runs, full API control, web import, a modes line-up, bring-your-own-model, a film and a waitlist. Light and dark themes, every colour a CSS variable.
designedFor: Launching a developer or design tool with a story rather than a feature grid
Showing a product's real interface, drawn in code so it stays sharp at any zoom
Waitlist and early-access pages that need one clear ask at the end
Studying pinned, scroll-triggered scenes built with Framer Motion and Lenis
